leaves.name: silverbergZarhinThm33
leaves.doc: Silverberg–Zarhin, Theorem 3.3, p. 405 (AI page read 11-17; provenance (b)). Both directions at the separable closure: semistability at a finite subextension (possibly the base) implies the criterion relating semistability at the base to triviality of inertia on the rational Tate module modulo its inertia invariants. Replaces the uncited L817–818 sentence through elliot_of_sz33 and the proved wild period.
